'''Medical Station One''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical]] facility on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[24 Tredway]] in the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]]. [[Dena Tredway]] was treated in the facility after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assault on the [[Tredway mine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
